name: dr-token
description: Dr. Token — an open-source AI coding token optimizer. Accuracy first.

scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @dr-token/core && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build --workspaces --if-present && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.benchmark: npm run build --workspaces --if-present && npm run benchmark --workspace @dr-token/benchmarks
scripts.level2: npm run build --workspaces --if-present && npm run level2 --workspace @dr-token/benchmarks --
scripts.level2:verify: npm run build --workspaces --if-present && npm run level2:verify --workspace @dr-token/benchmarks
scripts.verify:wire: npm run build --workspaces --if-present && npm run verify:wire --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test
scripts.verify:all: npm run verify && npm run verify:wire && npm run level2:verify
